batches.review_scope: Exhaustive archive, section and paragraph completeness checks; targeted five-language comparison of evidence boundaries, tactical terminology, conclusions and prose. This is not a claim of independent line-by-line historical certification of twenty manuscripts.
notes: Chinese and English pages, including the shared Traditional Chinese reading path, remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
EP05 preserves the distinction between later retellings of psychological assessments and verifiable original documents; it also retains the multiple competing lineages of the 4-2-4 formation.
EP06 preserves the distinction between understanding Garrincha's violence and excusing it, and retains conflicting accounts of the procedure allowing him to play the final.

EP06 supplied translations correctly say sent off, not shown a red card in 1962. Chinese uses the anachronistic red-card phrase. Retained as a disclosed source discrepancy; no silent edit to Chinese/English. FIFA confirms cards were introduced at the 1970 World Cup: https://inside.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/1966england/news/1966-world-cup-gripping-tales-and-inspirational-traffic-lights-2812820

EP07 supplied tactical terminology means without wingers, not without forwards, consistent with the described Hunt/Hurst frontline. Chinese's shorthand 无锋 is recorded as a source wording issue. FIFA reference: https://www.fifa.com/de/tournaments/mens/worldcup/articles/wm-1966-england-bundesrepublik-deutschland
EP07 keeps accusations separate from proof of manipulation and retrospective image reconstruction separate from an official re-ruling.

EP08 preserves personal appreciation versus a purported objective ranking, and differing time/participation counts versus genuinely different events. German title uses Farbaufnahmen rather than Farbfilm to avoid narrowing moving images to a particular medium.
Copyedits address awkward collocations and overpunctuated prose without abridging arguments or normalizing away the author's recurring motifs.

batches.review_scope: Exhaustive archive, section and paragraph completeness checks; targeted five-language editorial comparison of evidence boundaries, argument, conclusions and idiom. Not independent line-by-line historical certification of all twenty manuscripts.
notes: EP09 keeps aesthetic remembrance distinct from actually winning the title, and freedom of position distinct from the absence of collective discipline.

EP10 preserves the difference between documented political contacts and unproven mechanisms of match manipulation. The text does not infer individual players' complicity in repression from public appearances alone.

EP11 preserves the difference between sports sanctions, criminal conviction and Rossi's denial; later goals do not change the evidence. The source's closing phrase 永远没有终审 remains a rhetorical ambiguity in the inherited text, not independently certified here as a procedural claim about the case.

EP12's approved logical correction is applied to the Chinese and English shared page and all five supplied editions: the legitimate goal demonstrates skill not exhausted by the label cheat; it does not imply that someone who cheats cannot score a brilliant legitimate goal.

All other source HTML is protected byte-for-byte. The EP12 shared page currently exposes Chinese and English only; this batch does not add a new Traditional Chinese edition or claim a separate Traditional Chinese page was updated.
EP12 keeps the later revenge narrative distinct from an established premeditated purpose at the time of the match. No historical evidence has been added or upgraded to certainty.
